name: webpresa-pre-signup-link
description: Cognito Pre Sign-up trigger — links a Google-federated sign-in to an existing native user by email. Deployed via lambda.Code.fromAsset('src') with zero build step: the Node.js 24.x Lambda runtime bundles @aws-sdk/client-cognito-identity-provider, so this package.json is documentation only, not an install/bundle target. If a deploy ever fails with a module-not-found error for that package, that assumption was wrong — switch webpresa-user-pool.ts's Lambda construct to a bundled NodejsFunction instead.
